title: cargo-fallow JSON output
description: Each JSON document that cargo-fallow writes: the report of each command (also `fix`), the inspect report of `mutants --inspect`, the trace of `visibility --trace`, `deps --trace` and `dupes --trace`, the baseline file of `--save-baseline`, the snapshot of `check --save-snapshot`, the rule of `explain`, the report of `init` and the error document of exit code 2. The `document-<name>` definitions name each document.

auto_fixable.description: True when a tool can apply the step without a person.

Action.description: A next step for a finding.

oneOf.description: HEAD has a public path that the base does not have.
The base has a public path that HEAD does not have.
The header of an item at the path changed.
HEAD publishes a library that the base does not publish.
The base publishes a library that HEAD does not publish.
The base has a feature that HEAD does not have.

path.description:
The public path, or the feature name for `feature-removed`, or the
package name for a crate change.

item_kind.description: The kind of the item, or `null` for a crate or a feature change.

before.description:
The header at the base, or `null`. More than one header, for example
one for each `cfg` variant, are joined with ` | `.

file.description:
The file at HEAD. For a removal, the file of the nearest item around
the path at HEAD, else the package manifest.

version_base.description: The package version at the base, or `null`.

version_head.description: The package version at HEAD, or `null`.

breaking.description: True when the finding counts for the `api-removals` gate.

merge_base.description: The merge base of HEAD and the ref.

crates.description: The published libraries at the base or at HEAD.

clean.description: The run on the unmodified copy.

schema.description: The run on the schema build with no active mutant.

failures.description: The tests that fail on the unmodified copy. They decide no mutant.

regressions.description:
The tests that pass on the unmodified copy and fail on the schema build.
They decide no schema mutant.

tests_pass_with_schema.description: True when both runs completed and `regressions` is empty.

timeout_ms.description: The time limits from these runs.

Baseline.description: The baseline part of the report.

check.description: The check that found it, for example `deps`.

id.description: The stable id of the finding.

BaselineEntry.description: One finding in a baseline file.

schema_version.description: The version of the file shape.

kind.description: The command that saved the file.

identity.description: The key scheme of the ids.

findings.description: The findings, sorted by check, rule and id.

BaselineFile.description: The baseline file. The field order is the wire order.

matched.description:
The file entries that a finding of the run matched. The report leaves
out these findings.

stale.description:
The file entries of the checks that ran with no finding in the run.
A run with `--changed-since` does not judge them, so the list is empty.

from.description: The package or the module that the rule checks.

to.description: The denied package, pattern owner or module path.

pattern.description: The denied pattern, for a source rule.

dependency_kinds.description: The `Cargo.toml` sections of the dependency, for a crate rule.

origin.description: Where the path of an item rule is.

oneOf.description: A workspace package depends on a denied workspace package.
A file contains a denied pattern.
A module uses a denied module.
Code uses a denied workspace item, with the path resolved.
A `pub use <path>::*` re-exports a denied crate or module.

BoundariesKind.description: The kind of a boundary finding.

oneOf.description: In code.
In the tokens of a macro. The line is the line of the macro.

BoundariesOrigin.description: Where the path of an item rule finding is.

unresolved.description:
The uses that the item rules cannot resolve and that name a denied
item: a path that does not resolve to its end, a method call or a
field access. They give no finding.

workspace_edges.description: The dependency edges between workspace packages.

source_files.description: The files that the source rules read.

BoundariesSummary.description: The summary of a boundaries run.

base.description:
The fork point of the ref and `HEAD`: the commit that the diff starts
from.

changed_files.description: The changed files, relative to the workspace root, sorted.

ChangedFiles.description: The files that the working tree changed since the fork point of a ref.

oneOf.description: The parse of each target root file: the `parse-error` gate.
Unused dependencies, the same as `cargo fallow deps`.
Unused source files, the same as `cargo fallow files`.
Visibility in the fast mode, the same as `cargo fallow visibility`.
Boundary rules, the same as `cargo fallow boundaries`.
File and function size, the same as `cargo fallow size`.
Complexity, the same as `cargo fallow complexity`.
Duplicated code, the same as `cargo fallow dupes`.

schema_version.description: The version of the report shape.

checks.description: The checks that ran, in run order.

health.description: The health score of the Rust code, when a check with a penalty ran.

file_scores.description:
With `--file-scores`: the score of each source file, the least
maintainable first.

hotspots.description:
With `--hotspots`: the files that are complex and change often, the
riskiest first.

hotspot_summary.description: With `--hotspots`: the settings and the counts of the ranking.

health_trend.description: With `--trend` or `--trend-from`: the change against a snapshot.

findings.description: The findings of each check in the shared shape, in check order.

gate_outcomes.description: The gate outcomes of each check that ran, keyed by gate name.

changed_since.description:
The changed files of `--changed-since`. A run without the flag has no
such member.

packages.description:
The members of `--package`, sorted. A run without the flag has no
such member.

baseline.description:
The baseline of `--baseline`. A run without the flag has no such
member.

_meta.description: The meaning of each rule with a finding, with `--explain`.

sections.description:
The report of each check that ran, keyed by check name. Each report is
the JSON report of the command of the same name. The parse gate has no
report of its own.

CheckReport.description: The report of a `check` run. The field order is the wire order.

CheckSections.description:
The schema of the `sections` member: the report of each check that ran.
The report writes the map, so the type only describes it.

total_duplicated_lines.description: The sum of the line counts of the groups.

total_duplicated_tokens.description: The sum of the token counts of the groups.

CloneFamily.description: A set of clone groups in the same files.

fingerprint.description: A stable id: `dup:` and the hash of the normalized tokens.

instances.description: The places, sorted by file and line.

token_count.description: The number of tokens of the clone.

line_count.description: The largest line count of a place.

cyclomatic.description:
The cyclomatic complexity that the limit reads. With
`cyclomatic-policy = "flat-match"`, a flat `match` adds 1.

standard_cyclomatic.description:
The standard cyclomatic complexity, when the policy changed the value
of `cyclomatic`.

exceeded.description: The limits that the function went over.

crap.description:
The CRAP score: `CC^2 * (1 - cov)^3 + CC`, rounded to 1 decimal. It is
`null` for a unit with no score: no `DA` line, or a `cfg` attribute in
the body.

coverage_pct.description:
The line coverage of the function in percent, from 0 to 100. It is
`null` when `crap` is `null`.

oneOf.description: Over a limit, under the `high` band.
Cognitive 25 or more, or cyclomatic 30 or more.
Cognitive 40 or more, or cyclomatic 50 or more.

ComplexitySeverity.description: The severity band of a finding.

suppressed.description: The findings that a comment suppressed.

generated_files.description:
The files with a generator header or an `@generated` comment, which
the check skips.

skipped_files.description: The files that a declaration reached but that did not parse.

functions_without_coverage.description:
The units with no CRAP score: a unit with no `DA` line in the LCOV
file, or with a `cfg` attribute in its body. Only with `--coverage`.

stale_files.description:
The files with stale coverage data: the file is gone, or a `DA` line
is after the end of the file. Only with `--coverage`.

ComplexitySummary.description: The summary of a complexity run.

oneOf.description: The `DA` lines of an LCOV file.

CoverageSource.description: The source of the coverage of a score.

oneOf.description: The listed tests execute a line of the mutant.
The map has data on the lines, and no test executes them.
The map has no data on the lines, so a run has each test.

The mutant is in a constant context. The compiler can evaluate such code, so
the map says nothing about it, and a run has each test.

CoverageState.description: How the coverage map sees the lines of one mutant.

required_features.description: The features that the target needs.

externs.description: The crate names that the code can use.

auto_fixable.description: True when `cargo fallow fix` applies the step.

file.description: The file to change, relative to the workspace root.

DepsAction.description: A next step for one finding.

package.description: The package. A workspace finding has none.

manifest_path.description: The `Cargo.toml` path, relative to the workspace root.

line.description: The one-based line of the entry, when the scan found it.

section.description:
The table: `dependencies`, `dev-dependencies`, `build-dependencies`,
`workspace.dependencies`, or the ignore table of a `redundant-ignore`.

dependency.description: The key in `Cargo.toml`: the dependency name or its rename.

package_name.description: The package name of a renamed dependency.

used_by.description:
The parts of the package that use the dependency. Only a
`misplaced-dependency` finding has them.

actions.description: The next steps. `cargo fallow fix` applies a step with `auto_fixable`.

DepsFinding.description: One finding. The field order is the wire order.

schema_version.description: The version of the report shape.

findings.description:
The findings, sorted by manifest, line, table, key, platform, rule,
package and severity.

skipped.description: The packages that the run did not judge.

gate_outcomes.description: The gate outcomes, keyed by gate name.

DepsReport.description: The report of a `deps` run. The field order is the wire order.

oneOf.description: Counts for the `error-severity-findings` gate.
Does not count for a gate. The JSON value is `warn`.

DepsSkippedPackage.description: A package that the run did not judge.

schema_version.description: The version of the trace shape.

is_used.description:
True when code of a package that declares the dependency uses it.
`used` of each declaration tells which entry the code uses.

declarations.description:
The entries in Cargo.toml that declare the dependency, sorted by
manifest and line.

uses.description:
Each place in code that uses the dependency, sorted by package, file
and line.

findings.description: The findings of the `deps` check for the dependency.

skipped.description:
The declaring packages that the `deps` check does not judge, with the
reason, for example a file that did not parse.

DepsTrace.description: The trace of one dependency. The field order is the wire order.

manifest_path.description: The `Cargo.toml` path, relative to the workspace root.

line.description: The one-based line of the entry, when the scan found it.

package.description: The package. A `[workspace.dependencies]` entry has none.

key.description: The key in Cargo.toml: the dependency name or its rename.

code_name.description: The crate name in code, when the resolve gives it.

used.description:
True when code of the package of the entry uses the dependency: the
build script for a build entry, another part for another entry. A
`[workspace.dependencies]` entry is used when a member inherits it.

base.description:
The commit that the working tree is compared with: the fork point of the
ref and `HEAD`.

changed_files.description: The files with a changed line.

mutants_outside.description: The mutants that the run left out, because no line of the mutant changed.

production.description: True when the check leaves out test code.

generated_files.description:
The files with a generator header or an `@generated` comment, which
the check skips.

skipped_files.description:
The files that the check skips, with the reason: a file that did not
parse, or a file over the token budget.

DupesSummary.description: The summary of a duplication run.

schema_version.description: The version of the trace shape.

clone_groups.description:
The clone group with the fingerprint, as in the `findings` of a
`dupes` report.

DupesTrace.description: The trace of one fingerprint. The field order is the wire order.

ErrorOutput.description: The error document of exit code 2, on stdout with `--format json`.

message.description: The first line of the message.

ErrorSummary.description: One compiler error, without its spans.

oneOf.description: Only the cyclomatic limit.
Only the cognitive limit.
The cyclomatic and the cognitive limits.
Only the CRAP limit.
The cyclomatic and the CRAP limits.
The cognitive and the CRAP limits.
The cyclomatic, the cognitive and the CRAP limits.

Exceeded.description: The limits that a function went over.

rule.description: The rule name, as it appears in a finding.

severity.description: The severity of a finding: `error` or `warn`.

example.description: A short example of a finding.

ExplainRule.description: The explanation of one rule. The field order is the wire order.

workspace_crate.description: The workspace crate, or `None` for a crate outside the workspace.

platform.description: The `cfg` or target triple of a platform-specific dependency.

ExternRow.description: A crate name that the code can use.

path.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

maintainability_index.description:
The maintainability index from 0 to 100. Higher is better:
`100 - density * 30 * min(lines / 50, 1) - dead_code_ratio * 20`.

complexity_density.description: The cyclomatic complexity of all functions per line.

total_cyclomatic.description: The sum of the cyclomatic complexity of the functions.

total_cognitive.description: The sum of the cognitive complexity of the functions.

dead_code_ratio.description:
The `dead_public` findings per `pub` item of the file, from 0 to 1.
Only a run with the visibility check has it.

FileScore.description: The score of one source file.

FileSkip.description: A file that the walk reached but cannot use.

path.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

reason.description: Why the syntax cannot decide the files of the package.

FilesSkippedPackage.description: A package that the check skips, with the reason.

files.description: The `.rs` files in the target folders.

reached_files.description: The files that a target compiles.

skipped_packages.description: The packages that the check skips.

id.description:
A stable id: 16 hex digits of a hash of the check, the rule and the
identity of the finding. A run on the same code gives the same id.

check.description: The check that found it, for example `deps`.

related_locations.description:
The other places of the same finding, for example the other copies of
a clone.

Finding.description: One finding of one check. The field order is the wire order.

item.description: The item path from the crate root.

file.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

line.description: The one-based line of the name.

column.description: The one-based column of the name, in characters.

end_line.description: The one-based last line of the item.

suggested.description: The smaller visibility. An empty text means private.

test_only.description: True when only test code reaches the item.

type.description:
The action type of the finding: `remove-dependency` or
`move-to-dev-dependencies`.

package.description: The package. A workspace entry has none.

manifest_path.description: The `Cargo.toml` path, relative to the workspace root.

line.description: The one-based line of the entry before the edit.

applied.description: True when the command wrote the edit.

FixDependencyEdit.description: One planned edit. The field order is the wire order.

anyOf.description: An edit of a visibility keyword.

schema_version.description: The version of the report shape.

dry_run.description: True when `--dry-run` was given and no file changed.

fixes.description:
The edits, applied or planned: the `Cargo.toml` edits first, then the
visibility edits.

total_fixed.description: The number of edits with `applied: true`.

skipped.description:
The findings that `fix` does not change, for example a warning. A check
that `--only` or `--skip` leaves out adds nothing.

skipped_packages.description:
The packages that the `deps` check did not judge, so `fix` has no edit
for them.

FixReport.description: The report of a `fix` run. The field order is the wire order.

path.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

line.description: The one-based line of the keyword.

column.description: The one-based column of the keyword, in characters.

to.description: The new keyword. An empty text removes the keyword.

item_kind.description: The item kind, for example `function` or `reexport`.

applied.description: True when the command wrote the edit.

FixVisibilityEdit.description: One planned edit. The field order is the wire order.

files.description: The source files with a mutant.

files_skipped.description: The files that the walk reached but cannot use.

unreached_src_files.description:
The `.rs` files that no `mod` declaration reached: for example a file of a
macro-declared module, a test-only file or an unused file.

macro_tokens.description: Operator tokens in macro arguments and macro bodies.

const_context.description: Schema operators in constant contexts and patterns.

features.description: The features of this run. Other feature sets are not compiled.

doctests.description: True when the doctests ran for the survivors.

untested_dependents.description:
The workspace members that depend on the package and whose tests did not run.
`--test-workspace` runs them.

Gaps.description: What the run does not cover. A score says nothing about this code.

GateFile.description: A file that a gate judged.

GateFileReason.description: The reason that a gate judged a file.

crates.description: The crates: one for each target.

files.description: The parsed files, counted once for each crate.

skipped_files.description:
The files that a declaration reached but that did not parse. Their
items and uses are not in the graph.

unreached_files.description: The `.rs` files under the root folders that no declaration reached.

memory_limit_mib.description: The limit for one test process.

low_memory_percent.description: The floor of the free memory.

kills.description: The process trees that the guard killed.

GuardInfo.description: The guard part of the report.

anyOf.description: The score of a run on the whole workspace.

A run with a scope. The penalties count the whole workspace, so a run
that keeps only part of the findings gives no score.

Health.description: The health part of a report.

score.description:
The score, from 0 to 100, with one decimal. `None` when a check of
[`HealthScore::missing_checks`] did not run.

missing_checks.description:
The checks with a penalty that the run did not include. A score
without them reads too high, so the report has no score then.

penalties.description: The points that each penalty subtracts.

HealthScore.description: The health score of one language. The field order is the wire order.

schema_version.description: The version of the snapshot shape.

version.description: The version of cargo-fallow that wrote the snapshot.

timestamp.description: The time of the run, in ISO 8601 form in UTC.

git_sha.description: The commit of `HEAD`, when the workspace is in a git work tree.

formula_version.description: The version of the formula of the health score.

score.description: The health score. `None` for a run without a score.

penalties.description: The points of each penalty of the run, keyed by penalty name.

scoped.description:
True when the run kept only part of the findings: `--changed-since`,
`--package` or `--baseline`.

metrics.description: The change of each value that both runs have.

snapshots_loaded.description: The snapshots in the folder, or 1 for `--trend-from`.

overall_direction.description:
`improving`, `declining` or `stable`: the direction of the score, or
of the other values when a run has no score.

warnings.description:
Why some values are not comparable: another formula version, other
checks or another scope. Absent when the runs match.

HealthTrend.description: The trend of a run against a snapshot.

path.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

score.description: The churn times the complexity, from 0 to 100. Higher is riskier.

commits.description: The commits that changed the file in the window.

weighted_commits.description: The commits with a recency weight: a commit of 90 days ago counts half.

lines_added.description: The added lines in the window.

lines_deleted.description: The deleted lines in the window.

trend.description:
`accelerating`, `cooling` or `stable`: the commits in the newer half of
the `--since` window against the commits in the older half.

min_commits.description: The least number of commits for a hotspot.

files_excluded.description:
The source files with a commit in the window, but fewer than
`min_commits`.

shallow_clone.description:
True when the repository is a shallow clone. Then the run ranks no
file.

HotspotSummary.description: The settings and the counts of the hotspot ranking.

baseline.description: The baseline file, relative to the workspace root.

baseline_findings.description:
The findings that this run saved to the baseline, or `null` when the
run wrote no baseline.

written.description: True when the command changed the manifest or wrote the baseline.

InitReport.description: The report of `init`. The field order is the wire order.

state.description: How the map sees the lines of the mutant.

tests.description: The tests that execute a line of the mutant, sorted by name.

tests_without_data.description:
The tests with no usable data, sorted by name. A run has these tests for each
mutant.

InspectCoverage.description: The coverage part of an inspect report.

schema_version.description: The version of the report shape.

tier.description:
The tier of the mutant. A schema mutant can move to the rebuild tier in a run
when it breaks the schema build.

file.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

before.description: The whole lines of the mutant in the source.

after.description: The same lines with the mutant applied.

under_cfg.description: True when a `cfg` attribute is on an enclosing item.

InspectedMutant.description: The mutant of an inspect report.

end_col.description: The column after the last character.

LargeFile.description: A file over the line limit.

LargeFunction.description: A function over the function line limit.

path.description: The path relative to the workspace root, with `/` separators.

line.description: The first line, when the check knows it.

column.description: The first column, in characters, when the check knows it.

end_line.description: The last line, when the place is a range.

Location.description: A place in a file. Lines and columns start at 1.

oneOf.description: The run has no map, so each mutant runs each test.
The run built the map.
The run read the map from the cache.

MapSource.description: Where the coverage map of a run comes from.

manifest_path.description: The `Cargo.toml` path, relative to the workspace root.

targets.description: The targets, sorted by kind and then by name.

total_files.description: The source files that the module walk reached.

complexity_functions.description: The functions and closures outside the `exclude` list of `complexity`.

critical_functions.description:
Of those, the functions with cyclomatic complexity of
[`CRITICAL_CYCLOMATIC`] or more.

size_functions.description: The functions and closures outside the `exclude` list of `size`.

large_functions.description: Of those, the functions over [`LARGE_FUNCTION_LINES`] lines.

public_items.description: The `pub` items in the module graph.

declared_dependencies.description: The dependency entries in the `Cargo.toml` of the members.

unused_deps.description:
The `error` findings of `deps` on a member dependency. An unused
`[workspace.dependencies]` entry is not a member dependency, so it
does not count.

duplication_percentage.description: The duplicated lines as a percentage of all lines.

Metrics.description:
What the checks of one run measured. A field is `None` when its check did
not run.

MutantAction.description: A read-only next step for one mutant.

tier.description: The tier that ran the mutant.

file.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

line.description: The line in the original file, from 1.

column.description: The column in the original file, from 1, in bytes.

original.description: The start of the original text.

reason.description: The reason of a status without a test result.

retried.description: True when the mutant got a second run.

removed_from_schema.description: True when the mutant broke the schema and then ran in a rebuild.

under_cfg.description: True when a `cfg` attribute is on an enclosing item.

duration_ms.description: The wall time of the runs, in milliseconds.

tests_run.description: The nextest tests that gave a result with this mutant, over all runs.

doctests_run.description: The doctests that gave a result with this mutant, over all runs.

no_line_data.description:
True when the coverage map has no data on the lines of this mutant, so the
mutant ran each test.

actions.description:
The read-only next steps. The tool never writes a test or changes code, so
no action can be applied automatically.

schema_version.description: The version of the report shape.

gate_outcomes.description: The gate outcomes, keyed by gate name.

stopped_by.description: Why the run stopped before its last mutant.

elapsed_ms.description: The wall time of the run.

gaps.description: What the run does not cover.

workspace_tests.description: The run of the survivors against the tests of the workspace.

mutants.description: Each mutant, by tier, file and offset.

score.description: Detected mutants in percent, or `None` with no test result.

Penalties.description:
The points that each penalty subtracts. A penalty is `None` when its check

status.description:
`complete`, `nothing_to_decide`, `time_limit`, `memory_limit` or

leaves some candidates undecided.

candidates.description: The candidates of the fast check.

kept.description: The candidates whose item keeps its visibility.

kept_large_file.description: The kept candidates whose name is in a file over the size limit.

unresolved.description: The candidates that the database could not find.

large_files.description: The workspace files over the size limit.

load_ms.description: The milliseconds of the load, with build scripts and proc-macros.

elapsed_ms.description: The milliseconds of the whole mode.

message.description: The reason of a stop, or the last lines of the worker's stderr.

PreciseSummary.description: The result of the mode in the report.

line.description: The line of the first character.

column.description: The column of the first character.

Range.description:
A range of text with one-based lines and columns in characters. The end is
the position after the last character.

candidates.description: The mutants that the walk found.

unknown_return_types.description: The functions with a return type that has no known replacement.

probe_verified.description: False when a probe build had another error, so the probe proves nothing.

RebuildInfo.description: The rebuild part of the report.

how.description: How the loop found the mutant.

RemovedMutant.description: One mutant that the removal loop removed.

findings.description: The findings, in a fixed order.

gate_outcomes.description: The gate outcomes, keyed by gate name.

Report_of_SizeSummary.description: The report of one structure check. The field order is the wire order.

mutants.description: The number of mutants in this build.

RoundRecord.description: A record of one compile round.

oneOf.description: A `[dependencies]` entry that no code uses.
A `[dev-dependencies]` entry that no code uses.
A `[build-dependencies]` entry that the build script does not use.
A `[workspace.dependencies]` entry that no member inherits.
A `[dependencies]` entry that only test code, benches or examples use.
An optional dependency that no code uses. A feature names it.

A dependency that no code uses, and that a feature of the package
configures, for example `std = ["dep/std"]`.
An ignore entry that hides no finding.
A feature that turns on nothing, and that no code and no member names.

moved_to_rebuild.description:
The mutants that ran as a rebuild, because the schema build changes the result
of a test that can see them.

rounds.description: The compile rounds, or -1 when the schema never compiled.

source_bytes.description: The size of the source files.

schema_bytes.description: The size of the schema files.

candidates.description: The mutants that the walk found.

kept.description: The mutants in the final schema.

kept_under_cfg.description: The kept mutants under a `cfg` attribute.

kept_compile_checked.description: The kept mutants that a build reads, from the probe builds.

probe_verified.description:
False when a probe build had another error, so the probe proves nothing.
Then each mutant runs, and a survivor can be code that no build reads.

round_log.description: One record for each compile round.

last_errors.description: The errors of the last failed round.

SchemaInfo.description: The schema part of the report.

oneOf.description: The schema compiles.
The schema did not compile within the round cap.
The crate has no site.
The command did not select this tier.

SchemaStatus.description: The result of the schema build.

scope.description:
The scope of the run: `changed` for `--changed-since`, `package` for
`--package`, `baseline` for `--baseline`.

ScopedHealth.description: The health part of a run with a scope.

enabled.description: True when a coverage map selects the tests of each mutant.

map_ms.description: The time to build the map, in milliseconds. A cached map has 0.

tests_mapped.description: The tests with data in the map.

tests_unmapped.description: The tests with no usable data. Each mutant runs these tests.

tests_fail_alone.description: The tests that fail when they run alone with no mutant. They decide nothing.

mutants_without_line_data.description: The mutants with no coverage data on their lines, so they ran each test.

resumed.description: The mutants that the journal gave. These mutants did not run again.

tests_run.description: The sum of `tests_run` over the mutants.

doctests_run.description: The sum of `doctests_run` over the mutants.

SelectionInfo.description: The test selection part of the report.

oneOf.description: A finding that the rule counts as an error.

A finding that the rule counts as a warning. The JSON value is
`warn`, the same as in the fallow JSON output. SARIF keeps `warning`.

previous.description: The line count of the old version, or `None` for a new file.

old_path.description: The path of the old version, when a rename changed it.

SizeFinding.description: A file that the growth rule rejects.

oneOf.description: A file over the limit has more lines than its old version.
A new file is over the limit.

SizeKind.description: The kind of a growth finding.

compared_with.description:
The old version of the growth rule, or `None` without `--base` and
`--staged`.

checked_changes.description: The changed `.rs` files that the growth rule checked.

large_files.description: The checked files over the line limit, largest first.

large_functions.description: The functions over the function line limit, largest first.

skipped_files.description:
The files that the check skips, with the reason: a file that did not
parse, or a changed path that is not UTF-8 text.

SizeSummary.description: The summary of a size run.

path.description: The path relative to the workspace root.

Skipped.description: A file that a check skips, with the reason.

SkippedRow.description: A file that did not parse.

total_files.description: The files in the token streams.

duplicated_lines.description: The lines in a clone, counted once for each line.

duplicated_tokens.description: The tokens that a removal of the clones would save.

clone_instances.description: The places of all clone groups.

oneOf.description: A test failed with the mutant.
Each test passed with the mutant, also in the retry.
The tests did not end within the limit.
Two runs of the same mutant disagree.

No test can reach the mutant: no build reads it, or the package has no
test that passes.
The mutant does not compile.
The run has no test result: the memory guard killed it, or a runner failed.
The run stopped before this mutant, or the command ran no mutant.
The time budget ended.
The free memory stayed under the floor.

StopReason.description: Why a run stopped before its last mutant.

comment.description: The comment that suppresses the finding, for a `suppress-line` step.

placement.description: Where the comment goes, for a `suppress-line` step.

StructureAction.description: A next step for one finding. No step changes the code by itself.

Suite.description: The result of one test suite.

oneOf.description: The suite ran to its end.
The suite passed the time limit.
The runner or the build failed before the tests ended.

kind.description: The target kinds, for example `lib`, `bin` or `test`.

src_path.description: The root source file, relative to the workspace root.

edition.description: The Rust edition of the target.

TestRun.description: The two suites of one tree.

oneOf.description: In one build with all other schema mutants, selected by a runtime switch.
In its own rebuild of a scratch copy.

Tier.description: How the engine runs a mutant.

schema_nextest.description: A nextest run of a schema mutant.

schema_doc.description: A doctest run of a schema mutant.

rebuild_nextest.description: A nextest run of a rebuild mutant.

rebuild_doc.description: A doctest run of a rebuild mutant.

Timeouts.description: The time limit of each suite, in milliseconds.

path.description: The item path from the crate root.

crate_kind.description: The target kind of the crate.

visibility.description: The written visibility. An empty text means private.

file.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

line.description: The one-based line of the name.

exported.description: True when another crate can name the item.

is_used.description: True when a use or a hold keeps the item.

findings.description: The finding kinds of the item in the fast mode.

undecided.description:
The finding kinds that only an untyped credit stops. `--precise` mode
decides them.

holds.description:
The facts other than a use that keep the item or its visibility, for
example `glob-reexport` or `trait-impl`.

uses.description:
Each place in code that gives the item a credit, sorted by file and
line. A use inside the item itself and the `use` item of a re-export
are not in the list.

reason.description: A one-line summary of the verdict.

file.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

line.description:
The one-based line, or `None` when the place is not known. For macro
tokens, the line where the macro call starts. For an attribute, the
line of the attribute. For a documentation code block, the first code
line of the block.

context.description: The part of the package, as in the `used_by` list of a finding.

via.description: How the code uses the dependency.

name.description:
The crate name in the code. For `macro-crate`, the name of the macro
crate whose output uses the dependency.

file.description: The file, relative to the workspace root.

line.description:
The one-based line, or `None` when the place is not known, for a code
block of an included Markdown file. For macro tokens, the line where
the macro call starts. For an attribute, the line of the attribute.
For a documentation code block, the first code line of the block.

credit.description: How the code names the item.

class.description:
How sure the credit is: `exact`, `fallback` (the path did not resolve,
so each item with the name gets credit) or `untyped` (the syntax cannot
decide the type).

crate.description: The crate name of the code.

crate_kind.description: The target kind of the crate of the code.

under_cfg.description: True when a `cfg` that can be off is on the code.

TracedUse.description: One place in code that gives a credit.

name.description: `score`, `total_issues` or the name of a penalty.

direction.description:
`improving`, `declining` or `stable`. A higher score is better. A
lower penalty or issue count is better.

unit.description: `points` for the score and a penalty, `count` for the issues.

formula_version.description: The formula version of the snapshot score.

oneOf.description: An error span is inside the mutant arm.
An error span is inside the switch, outside each mutant arm.
No error span selects a mutant, so a bisection found it.

Via.description: The way that the loop found a broken mutant.

auto_fixable.description:
True for a `change-visibility` step of a finding with a keyword range:
`cargo fallow fix` applies it, and checks the build after the edit. A
change can still need a change in other code, so `fix` leaves out an
edit that breaks the build. An undecided candidate and a `remove-item`
step stay false.

from.description: The text to replace: the written keyword.

to.description: The new text. An empty text removes the keyword.

range.description:
The one-based position of the keyword, or `None` when the item has no
keyword of its own, for example an enum variant.

VisibilityAction.description: The change of the visibility keyword.

schema_version.description: The version of the report shape.

summary.description: The count of each finding kind.

gate_outcomes.description: The gate outcomes, keyed by gate name.

precise.description: The result of `--precise` mode. `None` in the fast mode.

crates.description: The crates of the graph: one for each target.

findings.description: The findings, sorted by file, line and kind.

undecided.description:
The candidates that only an untyped credit keeps: a method call, a field
access, or a name in macro tokens or in an attribute. They are not
findings. `--precise` mode decides them.

VisibilitySummary.description: The count of each finding kind.

schema_version.description: The version of the trace shape.

items.description:
The items with this path. A path can name more than one item, for
example a library and a binary with the same crate name, or two items
under different `cfg` conditions.

VisibilityTrace.description: The trace of one item path. The field order is the wire order.

WorkspaceSummary.description: The workspace part of the report.

mutants_run.description: The mutants that ran these tests.

detected.description: The mutants that these tests detected.

elapsed_ms.description: The time of this stage in milliseconds.

failures.description: The tests that fail with no mutant in the workspace run.

WorkspaceTests.description: The run of the survivors against the tests of each workspace member.
